**Finding: missing (INSURANCE)** — validated redline submitted.

- **Investigation:** A full-text search for "insurance" returned zero hits. Section 10 (General Provisions, p0059–p0070) covers Notices, No Joint Venture, Assignment, Waiver, Governing Law, Severability, Survival, Entire Agreement and Headings/Counterparts — no coverage requirement anywhere, and no indemnity clause either.
- **Why it matters:** HDI develops and hosts the Site, and Section 8.1 confirms it has access to "Content, user information, data" of the Company. A hosting vendor processing Customer Data with zero insurance sits in the rule's walk-away zone, not the fallback.
- **Fix:** Inserted a new Section 10.9 (Insurance) after p0070 at the preferred limits — CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request, running through the term plus one year. The comment flags the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) as a negotiable landing spot if HDI's existing program can't reach the preferred limits.
